question: According to the White Ribbon Alliance Respectful Maternity Care Charter, performing an episiotomy without informed consent constitutes physical abuse.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. This statement is true. The WRA framework classifies non-consented invasive procedures (including episiotomy, vaginal examination, fundal pressure) as physical abuse. Obtaining prior informed consent is both a professional and human rights obligation.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The WRA RMC Charter lists physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal abuse, stigma/discrimination, failure to meet professional standards, poor rapport/communication, and health system conditions as the seven categories of mistreatment. An episiotomy without consent falls under physical abuse — any non-consented invasive procedure does.
